name: EPIC 220380694
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 10.5 solar radii and 0.77 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,101 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.77 solar masses and 10.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,047 K at its surface.
